item.title: 3 deaths in Marion County linked to extreme cold, heavy snow
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS (WISH) — Three deaths happened during the recent cold temperatures in Marion County, the coroner’s office said in a news release issued Tuesday afternoon. On Saturday, 61-year-old William Johns Jr. was transported to the emergency room after being found in his home, which reportedly had no functioning heat. item.title: Immigration enforcement bill clears Indiana Senate amid national ICE controversy
item.description: The Indiana Senate passed a Republican-backed immigration enforcement bill that expands local cooperation with federal authorities and penalizes noncompliance, despite opposition from Democrats and the Indiana Attorney General.

item.title: Natural gas pipeline leak leads to evacuations in Bartholomew, Brown counties
item.description: A natural gas leak on a large main delivery pipeline in western Bartholomew County prompted evacuations in Bartholomew and Brown counties. A warming center was set up at a Nashville elementary school, and overnight accommodations were being established at the Brown County YMCA.

item.title: Purdue football’s 2026 schedule announced
item.description: Purdue football's 2026 schedule has been released, featuring games against Indiana State, Wake Forest, UCLA, Notre Dame, Illinois, Minnesota, Washington, Penn State, Maryland, Iowa, Wisconsin, and Indiana.

item.title: IU football’s full 2026 schedule released
item.description: IU football's 2026 schedule has been released, featuring games against North Texas, Howard, Western Kentucky, Northwestern, Rutgers, Nebraska, Ohio State, Michigan, Minnesota, USC, Washington, and Purdue.

item.title: Man fatally shot at Indianapolis apartments off West 38th Street
item.description: A man died in a shooting Tuesday evening at an apartment complex off West 38th Street in Indianapolis.

item.title: Watch: IU football honored before IU-Purdue basketball game
item.description: IU football celebrated their national championship with a trophy presentation at the IU-Purdue men's basketball game, where Curt Cignetti thanked the fans for their support.

item.title: IU takes down Purdue at Assembly Hall
item.description: The Hoosiers defeated the Boilermakers 72-67 at home, with Nick Dorn and Lamar Wilkerson leading the way with 18 and 19 points respectively, while Conor Enright added 8 points and 8 assists.
